The affix अच् comes after the verb हृञ् when it does not mean 'to raise up', when the object is in composition with it.

Terms: अच्

When the agent indicated is an animal, the affix इन् comes after the verb हृ 'to take', the object in composition with it being the words ददृति 'a leather bag' and नाथ 'a master'.

Terms: इन्
The affix फक् comes after the words हरित etc. when they end in the affix अञ् -- अनृष्यानन्तर्ये बिदादिभ्योऽञ्

The affix denoting 'fruit' is elided by लुप् after the words हरीतकी etc.

Terms: लुप्

The affix ठक् comes in the sense of 'he conveys thereby' after the words उत्सङ्ग etc. being in the Instrumental -3rd case in construction.

Terms: ठक्
